sources.title: Merged shared solar geometry
sources.evidence: Shared epoch JD 2461286.5: Moon uses ELP; Phobos uses a retained Horizons state; compact moon orbits and source-defined body orientation are prepared. Source comments distinguish parent barycenters from centers.
sources.scope: Moon, Phobos, Deimos; body-specific states and limitations

sources.title: NASA CGI Moon Kit
sources.evidence: The current color release mixes WAC color with monochrome polar information and gap filling. Numeric LOLA displacement products are also linked. The existing recipe uses a 2k image and print-map topography/crust inputs.
sources.scope: Moon surface and numeric height; visualization color is not a calibrated albedo map

sources.title: NASA lunar topography and crustal-thickness maps
sources.evidence: Both flat print maps contain baked shaded relief. GRAIL crustal thickness is a gravity-inferred model with a uniform crust-density assumption, not a direct thickness measurement.

sources.title: PDS LOLA/SLDEM2015 native float products
sources.evidence: Actual release directory exposes native float images and labels; datum, scale and spatial coverage must be taken from the selected label before preparation. No raster downloaded.

sources.title: PDS Diviner derived collection label
sources.evidence: Label identifies Moon target and derived thermal, rock-abundance and silicate-mineralogy products, with observation span 2009-07-05 to 2016-10-23. Retained label and hash in local-evidence.

sources.title: ODE Diviner Level 3 product guide
sources.evidence: The guide distinguishes Christiansen Feature wavelength, rock abundance and fitted soil temperature/RMS. Thermal products use specified lunar-hour bins; coverage and missing-data handling vary by product.
sources.scope: Moon composition proxy, rock abundance and local-time-conditioned thermal views

sources.title: Ernst et al. 2023 Phobos and Deimos SPC models
sources.evidence: Released SPC models include relative albedo and modeled gravity/slope attributes. Detailed SPC support is much less complete on Deimos; a closed mesh does not imply uniform measurement. Gravity interpretation includes density and Mars assumptions.
sources.scope: Phobos and Deimos geometry and facet attributes

sources.title: SBMT actual shared-file release index
sources.evidence: Index read through direct HTTP: Phobos v004 and Deimos v002 OBJ and matching CSV products are individually linked at several spacings. Phobos 18 m CSV is explicitly draft. No large archive downloaded.

sources.title: Phobos v004 148 m release label
sources.evidence: Label names the matching OBJ, migration from PCK10 to PCK11, removal of COM/COF offset, density, rotation and assumed Mars position. Retained with hash.
sources.scope: Phobos v004 frame and geophysical assumptions

sources.title: Deimos v002 83 m release label
sources.evidence: Label names the matching OBJ, 2025-03-10 release, nominal spacing, bulk density, spin and assumed Mars position. Retained with hash.
sources.scope: Deimos v002 model identity and geophysical assumptions

sources.title: USGS Phobos controlled mosaic record
sources.evidence: DLR-controlled Stooke mosaic already used in cssEarth. Nominal pixel spacing does not establish uniform image resolution; source illumination and artistic seam adjustment remain.

sources.title: PDS Stooke maps archive
sources.evidence: The retained Deimos cylindrical Viking/MRO mosaic belongs to this release. Current package already records interpolated polar areas and absence of a supplied validity mask.
sources.scope: Deimos existing mosaic; broader archive does not imply every map is a measured complete surface

sources.title: Shimizu et al. 2026 EXI Deimos crater and boulder distribution
sources.evidence: Abstract, published 2026-07-18, reports crater and boulder distributions from Hope EXI, including poorly observed areas. Full-text/data-availability endpoint returned 403; a downloadable registered feature catalog was not established.

sources.title: Emirates Mars Mission Science Data Center
sources.evidence: Primary science-data portal identified for EXI/EMIRS/EMUS observations; no specific Deimos calibrated sequence and complete geometry release selected in this review.

sources.title: TGO NOMAD-UVIS Mars-moon reflectance study
sources.evidence: Paper identifies ultraviolet/visible reflectance observations of both moons; this is a disk-spectrum/chart lead, not a registered global color texture. Exact PSA products remain to be pinned.

sources.title: PDS DART Dimorphos v004 collection
sources.evidence: Released final pre-impact global SPC collection is already the geometry source. Archive model uncertainty must remain separate from display-mesh simplification error.

sources.title: Dimorphos v004 relative-albedo table label
sources.evidence: Actual label has 196608 facet records with facet number, latitude, longitude, radius in km, relative albedo and sigma. It is a FITS binary table, not a cylindrical image. Retained with hash.
sources.scope: Dimorphos v004 .972 m matching-facet relative albedo

sources.title: Dimorphos v004 gravity-relative slope label
sources.evidence: Actual 196608-record table supplies slope and sigma in degrees. Label specifies uniform density, rotation and Didymos gravitational influence. This is distinct from radius-derived height.

sources.title: DART shape-model software interface specification
sources.evidence: Small PDF read: ancillary values correspond to plates of the matching shape; geophysical products use modeled gravity. Nominal global resolution does not establish useful detail everywhere.
sources.scope: DART shape and facet-product format and interpretation

rows.name: Moon
rows.geometry: Current 16-band reference sphere, radius 1737.4 km; topography is displayed as a print-map lens. Native LOLA/SLDEM numeric heights are released and could support preparation of actual relief with bounded simplification. SLDEM supports equatorial/midlatitude terrain; polar coverage requires the appropriate separate LOLA product.
rows.imagery: Existing 2k NASA visualization color plus LOLA/GRAIL print JPGs with baked shaded relief. GRAIL crustal thickness is gravity-inferred under a uniform crust-density assumption. NASA current color includes polar monochrome substitution and gap filling. Diviner RA/soil-temperature/RMS products cover 60 degrees south to 60 degrees north at 32 ppd in ten local-hour bins from 19:30 through 05:30; they are scientific layers, not photographs or a full-globe instantaneous thermal map.
rows.orbit: NAIF 301; merged solar geometry prepares an ELP Moon state at JD 2461286.5. Legacy SOURCE prose describes mean context and needs reconciliation with current code; no orbit implementation rerun.
rows.supportedRepresentation: Numeric topography and a carefully labeled Diviner thermal, rock-abundance or composition-proxy lens on the existing standalone Moon; lunar-hour bins and coverage visible in content. Optional genuine prepared relief after error/budget review.
rows.nextAction: Pin one Diviner GDR product with label/units/missing-data mask and native LOLA DEM; replace print-based elevation intake, qualify a new scientific layer, and correct stale orbit provenance.
rows.blocker: Selected raster labels and validity masks still need full intake; thermal local time is not the shared instantaneous scene date. Global imagery color includes reconstructed regions. No runtime or visual qualification performed.
rows.effortReason: Numeric scalar intake, legend/coverage semantics and relief preparation are broader than swapping an image; start with one well-defined lens.
searches: Read Moon SOURCE, raster/content and shared solar geometry at 7b289887.
Checked NASA CGI current products and polar/color caveats against current raster inputs.
Opened actual SLDEM float-image release directory.
Read Moon-target Diviner collection XML and GDR L3 product definitions, including spatial/local-hour limits; checked NASA 4014 print-map relief and crust-density caveats. No bulk raster downloaded.

rows.name: Phobos
rows.geometry: Ernst/SBMT v004 148 m model already supplies geometry, reduced to 1216 display facets. Higher-density releases exist; useful improvement depends on measured silhouette/relief gain, not file size. Frame label explicitly migrated PCK10 to PCK11 and removed COM/COF offset.
rows.imagery: Controlled 40 ppd Stooke multi-mission mosaic already present; nominal ~5 m pixels are not uniform 5 m detail. Companion facet-relative-albedo and geophysical attributes are released. Regional color and disk spectra require their own coverage/registration work.
rows.orbit: NAIF 401 relative to Mars 499; merged code retains a Horizons geometric state at shared epoch, alongside IAU rotation. Release model-frame consistency still needs a future visual/coordinate audit.
rows.supportedRepresentation: Existing observed mosaic plus separately labeled SPC relative-albedo or modeled gravity/slope lens, preserving source coverage and assumptions. A spectral chart is a later research candidate.
rows.nextAction: Use the matching v004 CSV attributes and model label to qualify one facet-scalar layer; compare source support and frame conventions before considering denser geometry.
rows.blocker: Facet attributes must preserve mesh identity and validity through preparation. Gravity/slope assumes density, rotation and Mars position; existing lit mosaic cannot be relabeled as albedo. New regional image registration and PSA spectrum product identity remain unresolved.
rows.effortReason: Matching geometry and attributes already exist; shared facet-scalar preparation and visual checks remain. Regional image or spectral work would be separate research.
searches: Read Phobos SOURCE, shape/raster preparation and content at 7b289887.
Matched exact Phobos v004 148 m OBJ/CSV/label names in SBMT index.
Read release frame/density/rotation/Mars-position label and Ernst product methods.
Checked controlled USGS mosaic and NOMAD-UVIS spectrum lead; did not treat paper metadata as released mapped texture.

rows.name: Deimos
rows.geometry: Ernst/SBMT v002 83 m model already used with 1216 display facets. Detailed SPC support is limited to part of the body; limb-constrained closure elsewhere is not equal-quality topography.
rows.imagery: Existing 20 ppd Viking/MRO mosaic includes coarse coverage, lit terrain, seam/polar interpolation and no source validity mask. The matching v002 facet attributes are released. July 2026 EXI crater/boulder paper is a new lead, but its registered feature-data release could not be verified.
rows.orbit: NAIF 402; current package uses prepared Mars-relative compact orbit and IAU orientation at shared date. A fresh reference fit was not performed.
rows.supportedRepresentation: Coverage-aware SPC scalar lens on current geometry; later registered EXI regional observation/feature view if calibrated sequences, geometry and data release are obtained. Disk spectra would support a chart, not a fabricated global color map.
rows.nextAction: Qualify one matching v002 facet-scalar layer and preserve the existing conservative NaN-albedo support mask; resolve the 2026 EXI paper data availability and exact EMM Deimos sequence before committing to an image/feature layer.
rows.blocker: Sparse SPC support and incomplete mosaic validity are material. New EXI paper full text returned 403; actual mapped crater/boulder release and image-to-shape geometry are unverified. A catalog entry or press image does not resolve registration.
rows.effortReason: Existing matching mesh/CSV permits bounded scalar work; EXI feature/imagery extension remains separate research and may be large.
searches: Read Deimos SOURCE, shape/raster preparation and content at 7b289887.
Matched exact Deimos v002 83 m mesh, CSV and released label; checked density/spin/Mars assumptions.
Reviewed SPC hemisphere limits and existing mosaic source lineage.
Searched Deimos EXI new products; read 2026 Shimizu abstract and attempted full-text/data-availability endpoint (403).
Identified EMM portal and NOMAD-UVIS paper, leaving exact product delivery/registration unresolved.

rows.name: Dimorphos
rows.geometry: Released DART v004 pre-impact .972 m SPC global mesh is already reduced to 800 display facets. Encounter mesh includes modeled terrain; simplifier error is separate from observational uncertainty. It cannot be presented as a measured post-impact shape.
rows.imagery: No photographic map is currently mounted. Actual v004 FITS binary-table release has per-facet relative albedo and sigma; gravity-relative slope is also released on the same 196608 facets. These provide a concrete path without first solving photographic frame projection.
rows.orbit: Existing DART s547 post-impact relative-trajectory fit uses a stated 60-day window; SOURCE records prior six-sample fit errors, not rerun here. The shape is pre-impact and display phase about the measured pole is arbitrary; no coupled post-impact attitude prediction is established.
rows.supportedRepresentation: Encounter-era relative-albedo and separately labeled gravity-relative slope views, retaining mesh-aligned valid/unknown support. Keep encounter shape, post-impact orbital context and arbitrary display phase distinct.
rows.nextAction: Add preparation support for the released v004 FITS facet table, join by FACET_NUM to the exact model, preserve sigma/no-data semantics and qualify a relative-albedo lens; slope follows with explicit density/rotation/Didymos assumptions.
rows.blocker: Existing cylindrical FITS path cannot ingest facet tables. A nonempty scalar or sigma alone does not prove observed coverage, and attributes must survive simplification without inventing detail. No future shape, spin or post-impact surface inferred.
rows.effortReason: The actual registered ancillary products are released; a reusable facet-table preparation path and coverage/visual qualification are the main work.
searches: Read Dimorphos SOURCE, content, material/shape preparation and source-orbit provenance at 7b289887.
Read PDS exact v004 collection and directory, not a generic DART landing page.
Fetched albedo and slope XML: checked target, logical ID, 196608 records, facet IDs, units and sigma.
Read DART shape SIS format and modeled-gravity interpretation; retained metadata hashes, no science array downloaded.

summary: All four existing local-system scenes have specific evidence-backed depth opportunities. The strongest shared implementation path is matching-mesh scalar preparation for Dimorphos, Phobos and Deimos; the Moon offers native numeric DEM and Diviner products. Deimos EXI 2026 is explicitly an unresolved data-release lead.
limitations: Review establishes feasible source directions, not qualified new assets, runtime correctness or release readiness.
Only small metadata/labels and the DART SIS were downloaded. Raster/mesh arrays and full ancillary validity have not been recomputed.
Mixed source epochs, frames, terrain support and visualization color treatments must remain explicit.
No new PR, implementation, build, tests, large source bake or external publication was performed.
